lesson.initial_question: When did Mina start, and whom did she meet on her first day?
lesson.initial_answer: She started on Monday and got to know her colleagues.
lesson.topic: reading a job advertisement, answering interview questions, and receiving a follow-up message

performance_activity.instruction: Role-play a short job interview: respond to the advertisement, describe past experience, say when you can start, ask a polite question, and report the first-day outcome.
prompts: Say why the job interests you
Answer Welche Erfahrung haben Sie? using Perfekt
Ask your own polite question with Könnten Sie ...?
Respond to Willkommen im Team and report the first day
